title: Steamed Jam Sponge Mug Cake
steps: Whizz oats in a mini blender to a flour; add baking powder and sweetener; whizz again.
Add vanilla extract, yogurt and egg; whizz until well combined.
Scrape half the mixture into a large mug; dollop in jam; add remaining mixture.
Microwave 1 minute 45 seconds. Check — top should feel firm and springy. If squidgy, add 30 more seconds.
Tip upside-down on to a plate (jam will sit on top). Eat warm.
notes: Try golden syrup or chocolate spread instead of raspberry jam.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021, Aster/Octopus)
